Mini-drone DSP lab: before and after

All figures were produced on this machine (MATLAB R2026b, base only). ESP32 plots use a simulated log until real rig data exists.

1 · Live camera vision (index.html)

Same realistic frame: warm wooden floor, hand, red clutter, 2 px red cable. True angle 7.1°, offset 0 px.

3 · ESP32 + MPU6050 rig analysis (esp32_mpu6050_analysis.m)

Before, it needed the Signal Processing Toolbox and a file name the app never writes. Now it finds the newest mpu6050_log*.csv, or runs on a clearly labelled SIMULATED log. New plots: frequency response, pole-zero, spectrogram.

Before

No graphs produced.
Undefined function iirnotch / butter / fir1 / filtfilt / grpdelay (no Signal Processing Toolbox)
and: mpu6050_log.csv not found (the app saves mpu6050_log_<time>.csv)

After

MetricBeforeAfter
Figures04 (3 new types)
IIR vs FIR delay at 1 Hz–82 ms vs 200 ms
Roll RMSE at 30° hold, raw → IIR–8.57° → 1.41° (simulated)

4 · Simulink blocks (matlab/simulink/)

Before, they used medfilt2/strel/edge/hough (toolbox-only) and had never been run. Now they are toolbox-free, fixed-size and code-generation friendly, with the same ROI/blob/refine fixes, and test_simulink_blocks.m passes. Not yet run inside Simulink (not installed here).
